name: Concord Control Systems Limite
summary: Concord Control Systems Ltd. develops and manufactures a range of electrical and electronic goods specifically for the Indian railway system and other railway contractors. Their offerings for railway coaches include key components like inter-vehicular couplers, emergency lighting systems, brushless DC carriage fans, exhaust fans, cable jackets, and bellows. Additionally, the company provides essential equipment for the electrification of coaches and the broad gauge network of Indian Railways, such as 200 AH and 40 AH battery chargers, and tensile testing machines. Founded by Nitin Jain and Gaurav Lath on January 19, 2011, Concord Control Systems Ltd. is headquartered in Lucknow, India.
